newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RGC unconcerned over any Hanson stake sale.
newsitem.headline: RGC unconcerned over any Hanson stake sale.

text.p: Australian mining group RGC Ltd's managing director Mark Bethwaite said on Friday he was not unduly concerned over the possible sale of Hanson Plc's 40 percent stake in RGC.
"I'm not unduly concerned ... our responsibility is to all our shareholders, not just Hanson," Bethwaite told Reuters.
Hanson deputy chairman Chris Collins said in London on Thursday that Hanson's 40 percent interest in RGC was "not long term."
Bethwaite said it came as no surprise that Hanson, which has been a shareholder in RGC for eight years, has excluded RGC from its core business assets.
However, Hanson for the time being remains a "supportive shareholder" in RGC, he said.
RGC shares closed two cents higher at A$3.70 on Friday, a level which would value Hanson's stake at about A$310 million.
